product_overview: A personal portfolio website showcasing the developer’s background, technical skills, services, and selected projects. It also provides multiple ways for visitors to get in touch through contact forms and contact links.
core_goals: Explore the developer’s background and experience
Review technical skills and offered development services
Browse showcased projects and filter them by category
Contact the developer through an on-site form or contact links

features.name: Navigation
features.description: A site-wide navigation system that lets visitors move between the main portfolio pages and access the contact page quickly.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click the About link -> View the About page
Navigate to / -> Click the Services link -> View the Services page
Navigate to / -> Click the Projects link -> View the Projects page
Navigate to / -> Click the Contact link -> View the Contact page
Navigate to / -> Click the Hire Me action -> View the Contact page
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile navigation drawer -> Select a page link -> View the chosen page and close the drawer

features.name: Hero Section
features.description: The home page introduction that presents the developer’s name, role, summary, and primary calls to action.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero introduction and summary -> Choose to view projects -> View the Projects page
Navigate to / -> View the hero introduction and summary -> Choose to hire the developer -> View the Contact page

features.name: Skills Section
features.description: A home page section that highlights backend and frontend technologies in card format.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the skills section -> View the backend skill set card
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the skills section -> View the frontend skill set card

features.name: Services Preview
features.description: A home page preview of the services offered, with a link to the full services listing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the services preview section -> View the service cards
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the services preview section -> Open the full services listing -> View the Services page

features.name: Featured Projects Preview
features.description: A home page preview of selected projects with access points for project demos and code repositories.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the featured projects section -> View the project cards
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the featured projects section -> Open the projects gallery -> View the Projects page
Navigate to / -> Scroll to a featured project card -> Open the live demo link -> Observe the linked project destination
Navigate to / -> Scroll to a featured project card -> Open the GitHub link -> Observe the linked repository destination

features.name: Contact Form on Home Page
features.description: An inline contact form on the home page that allows visitors to enter contact details and a message.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Fill in the full name, email address, subject, and message -> Submit the contact form

features.name: About Page
features.description: A dedicated page that presents the developer biography, technology stack, and experience timeline.
user_flows: Navigate to /about -> View the biography section -> View the technology stack -> View the experience timeline

features.name: Services Page
features.description: A dedicated page that lists all development services offered by the developer.
user_flows: Navigate to /services -> View the complete services list

features.name: Projects Filter
features.description: A projects gallery that lets visitors narrow the displayed work by category.
user_flows: Navigate to /projects -> View all projects -> Select the Full Stack filter -> View only matching projects
Navigate to /projects -> View all projects -> Select the Frontend filter -> View only matching projects
Navigate to /projects -> View all projects -> Select the Backend filter -> View only matching projects
Navigate to /projects -> View all projects -> Select the All filter -> View the complete project gallery

features.name: Contact Page
features.description: A dedicated contact page with a detailed form, expandable FAQ, and direct contact links.
user_flows: Navigate to /contact -> Fill in the name, email, subject, and message -> Submit the contact form
Navigate to /contact -> Select a FAQ question -> View the answer -> Select it again -> Hide the answer
Navigate to /contact -> Open the email contact link -> Start a new email message
Navigate to /contact -> Open the LinkedIn contact link -> View the linked profile destination

features.name: Footer
features.description: A site footer containing branding, copyright information, and external social/contact links.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the footer -> Open the email link -> Start a new email message
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the footer -> Open the GitHub link -> Observe the linked destination
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the footer -> Open the LinkedIn link -> Observe the linked destination
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the footer -> Open the Twitter link -> Observe the linked destination

routes.description: Home page with hero, skills, services preview, projects preview, and contact form
About page with bio, tech stack, experience timeline
Services page listing all offered development services
Projects gallery with filter tabs (All, Full Stack, Frontend, Backend)
Contact page with form, FAQ accordion, and social links

features.name: Navigation
features.description: Sticky top navbar with links to all pages and Hire Me CTA button. Mobile hamburger menu with animated drawer.
user_interactions: Click logo to go to home
Click About, Services, Projects, Contact nav links
Click Hire Me button to navigate to /contact
Click hamburger menu on mobile to open drawer
Click any drawer link to navigate and close drawer

features.name: Hero Section
features.description: Home hero with name, title, bio, CTA buttons (View Projects, Hire Me), and stats counter. Animated terminal card.
user_interactions: Click View Projects button to navigate to /projects
Click Hire Me button to navigate to /contact

features.name: Skills Section
features.description: Two skill cards on the home page showing Backend and Frontend tech stacks with tags.
user_interactions: Scroll to view animated skill cards

features.name: Services Preview
features.description: Grid of 8 service cards on home page with a View All Services link.
user_interactions: Scroll to view service cards
Click View All Services to navigate to /services

features.name: Featured Projects Preview
features.description: Two featured project cards on home page with Live Demo and GitHub links. View All Projects CTA.
user_interactions: Scroll to view project cards
Click View All Projects to navigate to /projects
Click Live Demo link on a project
Click GitHub link on a project

features.name: Contact Form (Home)
features.description: Inline contact form on home page with name, email, subject, message fields and send button.
user_interactions: Fill Full Name input
Fill Email Address input
Fill Subject input
Fill Message textarea
Click Send Message button to submit

features.name: Projects Filter
features.description: Projects page with filter tabs (All, Full Stack, Frontend, Backend) that filter displayed project cards.
user_interactions: Click filter tab to filter projects
View filtered project cards

features.name: Contact Form (Contact Page)
features.description: Full contact page with detailed form, FAQ accordion, and contact info links.
user_interactions: Fill name, email, subject, message fields
Click Send Message button
Click FAQ question to expand/collapse answer
Click email or LinkedIn contact links

features.name: Footer
features.description: Footer with logo, copyright text, and social links (GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter, Email).
user_interactions: Click GitHub link
Click LinkedIn link
Click Twitter link
Click Email link to open mailto

known_limitations.issue: Contact forms are UI-only; no backend API connected — form submissions are not sent anywhere
known_limitations.impact: Send Message button does not actually submit data to any server

known_limitations.issue: Live Demo and GitHub links on project cards are placeholder "#" hrefs
known_limitations.impact: Clicking Live Demo or GitHub does not navigate to real project URLs

known_limitations.issue: Social links in Footer are placeholder "#" hrefs except Email
known_limitations.impact: GitHub, LinkedIn, and Twitter links do not navigate to real profiles
